name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Take the key, then open the door' is captured by hard Existence(door_open) with hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), which together force the key (no redundant Existence(has_door_key)); 'After that, try to pick up the box' keeps the stated order hard as Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) while the preference cue 'try to' makes only Existence(target_picked_up) soft. All four clauses trace to the task, the machine reaches FINAL_STATES u3 only with door_open (and the key forced by the chain), and target_picked_up before door_open correctly falls into the rejecting state.

texts: The door is not opened before the matching key has been acquired.
The target box is not picked up before the door has been opened.
Try to pick up the target box.
